quarterly_data.quarter: AEM Holdings press release: Higher AI Test Demand Drives Up AEM's 1H Profits (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 1H2026 results (six months to June 30, 2026; S$ '000): revenue 247,207, up 29.9% year on year (2Q 130,347, up 11.5% QoQ), driven by a 191.7% rise in revenue from the group's fabless AI / HPC customer (not named), now its largest revenue contributor; profit before tax 38,208 (PBT margin 15.5%, up 13.4 points); net profit 30,791 (1H2025 3,156); EPS 9.7 cents. Test Cell Solutions revenue grew 52.5% to S$180.9 million (73.2% of revenue) on highly parallel, thermally controlled test for advanced AI / HPC devices; Contract Manufacturing external revenue S$63.2 million (-5.7%), with inter-segment sales up 363.6% to support the AMPS ramp. Device-specific configurables and collaterals reached S$72.3 million in 2Q2026, up 12.6% QoQ. CEO Samer Kabbani: customers are turning to precise thermal control, highly parallel testing and full-stack integration as devices become more complex and power-dense.
quarterly_data.figure: 1H2026 revenue S$247.2 million (+29.9% YoY); PBT S$38.2 million; fabless AI / HPC customer revenue +191.7%

quarterly_data.quarter: AEM Holdings press release: Higher AI Test Demand Drives Up AEM's 1H Profits (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company guidance (August 12, 2026): FY2026 revenue guidance raised to S$630 million - S$680 million from S$550 million - S$600 million, supported by the production ramp of its fabless AI / HPC customer, the PC / Foundry customer's adoption of the AMPS platform for future test requirements and the planned shipment of its first memory final test handler in 4Q2026 ahead of a ramp in 2027; full-year EPS guided at 24.5 to 27.5 cents. Its growth strategy has five pillars: PC / Foundry, AI / HPC, Memory, OSATs and Contract Manufacturing.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 revenue guidance S$630 million - S$680 million (was S$550 million - S$600 million); EPS 24.5 - 27.5 cents
